meta.encoding: squares["mapX_mapZ"]["level"] is a run-length-encoded array of [regionId, runLength] pairs, row-major over local tiles in localZ*64+localX order (0..4095). regionId 0 = not walkable / no region. World coord -> region: mapX=worldX>>6, mapZ=worldZ>>6, localX=worldX&63, localZ=worldZ&63, index=localZ*64+localX, then find the run containing that index.
